cards.title: Stage 1: how it feels now
cards.text: Your notes from playing it, all done except the menu and status rules. It's live now. Mark any part that's off.
cards.why: This is the base everything else builds on: how units move, hit and look in a fight.
cards.details:
The clip is a real depth 1 room at normal speed, recorded in portrait at iPhone size.

Not in this stage: the menu and camp (redone with the progression in stage 3, mocked up first) and the status rules (stage 4). Base attacks still apply chill and poison until then.

The four art artists start at 2am, once the weekly limit resets.

parts.title: Portrait
parts.text: Hold the phone either way. Upright, the room turns so you walk up the screen, and the camera follows the party. Sideways still works.

parts.title: Bigger rooms and bodies
parts.text: Rooms are 25% bigger. Bodies now collide at the shoulders, not the head, so they don't overlap. Melee reach shrank to match.

parts.title: Momentum and turning
parts.text: Units speed up and slow down, swing round at their own turn speed (knight slowest, rats fastest), and a sharp turn bleeds speed.

parts.title: Animations
parts.text: A waddle and bounce when walking, a lunge on each swing, bow recoil, a pull-back before heavy blows, and enemies pop and fade when they die.

parts.title: Hit impact
parts.text: Hits squash and shove the target, throw sparks, and damage numbers land big. Heavy hits and crits freeze the action for a split second and shake the screen.

parts.title: Outlines, arrows, rats
parts.text: One outline thickness for everything. Arrows about twice the size, with fletching. Rats bigger.

parts.title: Fire and statuses
parts.text: Fire is outlined flame licks instead of orange puffs. Statuses tint the unit and show as a small meter under its health bar; frozen units sit in an ice block.

parts.title: Brains
parts.text: Targets nobody's on come first, packs are avoided (the rogue most), the rogue strafes away from groups. Knight draws attention and protects; archer stays behind him. Rats zigzag in and circle.
